page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at the top with the page number to its left. No marginal notes. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: Quemadmodum piscatores seduli, ubi sagenam euacuauerūt, statim cū occasio suadet, alios piscēs capiendi gratia, eam laxatam demittunt: sic Nebucadnezar Rex Chaldæorum, quo plures populos & prouincias in ditionem potestatemq; suam redegerit, eo pluribus inuncandis inhiabit. Est enim, ut sæpe dicitur, συμφω- τομένων [?] τὰς ἀλλογαγίας [?], ἡ πλεονεξία [?].
main_text.head: 8. ARGVMENTVM HABACVCI, ἡ πλεονεξία [?] Chaldæorum.
main_text.p: Interest totius humani generis, ac in primis Ecclesiæ, quæ nunquam non à filijs huius seculi oppugnatur, diuinitus co-erceri tyrannorum πλεονεξίας [?] & perpetuas molitiones, quæ eò spectant, ut omnes populos sibi subijciant, & ut in quosuis sæuiant. Ac recte monuit Theognis, lucri causa tyrannos non esse iuuandos: μήτι τὴν αὐξῆ τύραννον ἐπ' ἐλπίσι λάβρδεος εἶναι [?].
Sed Nebucadnezar & Chaldæi nil nisi cædes, rapinas, feruitutem alienam, moliuntur & spirant.
Quare plurimum refert, à Deo Nebucadnezarem cum suis administris nō tantum coerceri, sed etiam rapacitatis insatiabilis & malorum consiliorum & conatuum

page.notes: The Greek passages are uncertain and marked [?] where I could not read the letters with confidence. The Greek in the heading line is a printed form that I could not confirm. The Latin "coeceri" is printed as shown and may be a misprint for "coerceri". A faint mark at the lower left is not clearly a signature and is omitted. The long s in "Elt" was read as "Est".
